name: Quick Todo
notes: Set YOUR_DOMAIN to your deployed site.
Configure CAPTURE_API_KEY in the server environment and store the same value only in the private Shortcut Authorization header.
Before Get Contents of URL, add a Generate UUID action and pass its result as Shortcut UUID.
Shortcut Input can be dictated text, clipboard text, a share-sheet value, or a prompt result.
A first capture returns 201; retrying the same UUID and title returns 200 without a second task; reusing the UUID with changed content returns 409.
